prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1278; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle shows a side impact to the driver's rear quarter panel, with a crushed rear door, a cracked taillight lens, and scuffing along the rocker panel. Some of the lower body damage may not be from this collision, and the shop should confirm that before repair begins. The billing shows no repeated charges. The labor hours are slightly high for the damage described, so a review of the time allowances is recommended. No prior damage to this vehicle is known. The plan is to replace the rear door shell, refinish the affected panels, and install a new taillight assembly, with the rocker panel repaired only if the teardown confirms it was damaged in this loss.
